title: Identity and nomenclature for one substance (monograph section 2)
description: Names, chemistry, forms, street names by region and date, and drug-checking findings, each with its source. Street names are reported as documented by monitoring bodies, never as advice.

compiled_by.description: Who compiled the section and how the pages were read (METHODS §10.3).

checked_by.description: The second reader and how they checked (METHODS §10.3: ai-checked).

members.description: For a page that covers a class (benzodiazepines, synthetic cathinones…): the members the page covers, each with its own identifiers and sources.

hold.description: Why the finding is not shown yet, e.g. a paper read only through WebFetch (METHODS §12.1: papers are read in full text, never through WebFetch).

read_via.description: How the page was read (METHODS §10.3, §12.1): WebFetch answers through a summarizing model, so facts read that way stay draft until confirmed in a second source or by a second reader.

note.description: How the page was read in detail (e.g. numbers re-read in a second fetch); not shown as a source title.
